name: XUGA Island Wear
talesLine: Every XUGA piece has a tale.
description: XUGA upcycles worn-out beach towels into one-of-a-kind island wear in Malta. Every piece carries a code: scan it and the towel tells you where it has been.
footerTagline: Every XUGA piece has a tale.
footerBlurb: XUGA is a student-led island-wear brand in Malta, stitching tired beach towels into clothes worth keeping.
